cover.caption: Reven har en hel haug med fisk, og bjørnen vil så gjerne lære å fiske.
cover.alt: Reven sitter i snøen ved et islagt vann og holder fram en haug med blanke fisk. Den store, brune bjørnen med lang, buskete hale bøyer seg ned og ser på fisken med store øyne.
cover.prompt: On the snowy shore of the Frozen Lake, the Fox sits up on his haunches and proudly holds out his bundle of five silver fish, with a sly grin. The Bear, huge beside him, leans down towards the fish, sniffing, with big, admiring eyes, his long bushy tail curled round in the snow behind him. Snow-laden spruces and a pale, low winter sun behind them, and the frozen lake stretching away, white and blue.

Create the cover illustration for a children's picture book, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: On the snowy shore of the Frozen Lake, the Fox sits up on his haunches and proudly holds out his bundle of five silver fish, with a sly grin. The Bear, huge beside him, leans down towards the fish, sniffing, with big, admiring eyes, his long bushy tail curled round in the snow behind him. Snow-laden spruces and a pale, low winter sun behind them, and the frozen lake stretching away, white and blue.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Fox: A slim, light-footed, long-legged red fox with sleek, bright flame-red fur, a snow-white chin, throat and chest, black lower legs and paws, tall pointed ears with black backs, narrow amber eyes with a sly sideways glance, a long, pointed snout with long whiskers and a cheeky lopsided grin. His big, bushy red tail ends in a clean white tip.
- the Bear: A huge, heavy, slow-moving bear, taller than a man when he stands up, with thick, shaggy dark chocolate-brown winter fur, a broad head with small round ears, small, gentle black eyes under heavy brows, a short greyish-tan muzzle with a big black nose, and a patient, slightly puzzled look. He has enormous flat paws with blunt claws and, unlike bears today, a long, fine, plume-like bushy tail that reaches the ground and sweeps the snow behind him.

Setting:
- the Frozen Lake: A small, round forest lake frozen solid, its thick ice pale grey-blue and dusted with snow, ringed by tall, snow-laden spruces and a few bare birches. Snowy reeds poke up along the shore, round boulders wear caps of snow, the shore is a soft, deep snowbank, and gentle white hills rise beyond.

Story world: A snowy forest in old Norway, long ago, where the animals can talk. Below the spruce woods lies the Frozen Lake, a small forest lake covered with thick, snow-dusted ice. Up the hill is the Sunny Slope, an open clearing where the low winter sun shines, with one dense, dark spruce bush at its upper edge. The fox's bundle of fish is five plump silver fish tied together by their tails with a piece of string. The butter tub is a small, round wooden keg with a flat lid and two bent-wood hoops, about as tall as the fox, full of bright-yellow butter. The bear and the fox are natural wild animals without clothes: they walk on four legs, but can sit up and use their front paws like hands.

This story's season, light and colours: Deep midwinter in bright, dazzling sunshine: sparkling white snow, a clear turquoise-blue sky, cool blue shadows and hoarfrost glittering on every twig, with the frozen lake a pale grey-blue. Near Christmas the Sunny Slope basks in warm lemon-yellow sunshine, and the last picture is a clear, deep-blue evening with a lemon glow low in the sky and the first stars. Accents: the fox's flame red, butter yellow and dark spruce green.

Art style: Warm Scandinavian children's picture-book illustration: gouache and watercolour on lightly textured cold-press paper, with soft coloured-pencil outlines and visible brush and paper texture. Rounded, friendly shapes and simple, expressive faces with clear emotions, but every character has their own face shape, nose, eyes, hair, build and age exactly as described, so no two characters look alike. Base palette of moss green, spruce green, lingonberry red, birch white, fjord teal, honey yellow and warm earth browns, shifted towards each story's own season, light and colours. The pictures are the colour plates of a classic printed storybook with warm cream pages, so the lightest tones are warm and creamy, never stark white, and lingonberry red is the accent that comes back in every picture. The picture fills the whole image, with no border, frame or lettering. Costumes and places from old rural Norway: spruce and birch forests, fjords and mountains, turf-roofed log houses, carved wood, rosemaling patterns, wool and linen clothes. Kings and princesses wear simple storybook finery. Trolls are huge, lumpy and mossy and look silly rather than scary. Clear, uncluttered composition with one focal point and room to breathe. Cosy, safe and full of wonder. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, no glossy digital look.

characters.name: Den stubbrumpete bjørnen
characters.description: Den samme snille bjørnen etter isfisket, nå med bare en liten halestump igjen; han blir aldri sint lenge og stoler fortsatt på reven.
characters.look: The same huge, heavy, slow-moving bear after his fishing trip: thick, shaggy dark chocolate-brown winter fur, a broad head with small round ears, small, gentle black eyes under heavy brows, a short greyish-tan muzzle with a big black nose, a patient, slightly puzzled look and enormous flat paws with blunt claws. His long tail is gone: all that is left is a tiny, round, fluffy stump on his big round bottom.

illustrations.anchor: Reven sto et stykke unna med fisken sin og gliste.
illustrations.caption: Bjørnen stikker halen ned i det iskalde vannet. Brrr!
illustrations.alt: Bjørnen sitter ute på isen med halen nede i et hull og hutrer med øynene igjen. Inne ved land sitter reven på en stein med fisken sin og gliser.

- the Fox: A slim, light-footed, long-legged red fox with sleek, bright flame-red fur, a snow-white chin, throat and chest, black lower legs and paws, tall pointed ears with black backs, narrow amber eyes with a sly sideways glance, a long, pointed snout with long whiskers and a cheeky lopsided grin. His big, bushy red tail ends in a clean white tip.

Setting:
- the Sunny Slope: A gentle, south-facing clearing on a snowy hillside in the spruce forest, where the low winter sun shines all day: smooth, sparkling snow with a few grey rocks and tufts of dry golden grass poking through, and at its upper edge one dense, dark-green spruce bush whose low branches sweep the snow, leaving a hollow underneath. Tall spruces and birches ring the clearing, with blue hills far away.

Story world: A snowy forest in old Norway, long ago, where the animals can talk. Below the spruce woods lies the Frozen Lake, a small forest lake covered with thick, snow-dusted ice. Up the hill is the Sunny Slope, an open clearing where the low winter sun shines, with one dense, dark spruce bush at its upper edge. The fox's bundle of fish is five plump silver fish tied together by their tails with a piece of string. The butter tub is a small, round wooden keg with a flat lid and two bent-wood hoops, about as tall as the fox, full of bright-yellow butter. The bear and the fox are natural wild animals without clothes: they walk on four legs, but can sit up and use their front paws like hands.

This story's season, light and colours: Deep midwinter in bright, dazzling sunshine: sparkling white snow, a clear turquoise-blue sky, cool blue shadows and hoarfrost glittering on every twig, with the frozen lake a pale grey-blue. Near Christmas the Sunny Slope basks in warm lemon-yellow sunshine, and the last picture is a clear, deep-blue evening with a lemon glow low in the sky and the first stars. Accents: the fox's flame red, butter yellow and dark spruce green.

Art style: Warm Scandinavian children's picture-book illustration: gouache and watercolour on lightly textured cold-press paper, with soft coloured-pencil outlines and visible brush and paper texture. Rounded, friendly shapes and simple, expressive faces with clear emotions, but every character has their own face shape, nose, eyes, hair, build and age exactly as described, so no two characters look alike. Base palette of moss green, spruce green, lingonberry red, birch white, fjord teal, honey yellow and warm earth browns, shifted towards each story's own season, light and colours. The pictures are the colour plates of a classic printed storybook with warm cream pages, so the lightest tones are warm and creamy, never stark white, and lingonberry red is the accent that comes back in every picture. The picture fills the whole image, with no border, frame or lettering. Costumes and places from old rural Norway: spruce and birch forests, fjords and mountains, turf-roofed log houses, carved wood, rosemaling patterns, wool and linen clothes. Kings and princesses wear simple storybook finery. Trolls are huge, lumpy and mossy and look silly rather than scary. Clear, uncluttered composition with one focal point and room to breathe. Cosy, safe and full of wonder. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, no glossy digital look.

Rules:
- No text of any kind: no letters, words, numbers, signatures, captions, speech bubbles or logos.
- Every named character must match their model sheet and description exactly: the same face, hair, colours, clothes and proportions.
- Gentle and safe for young children: no blood, wounds or gore, and no violence in progress. Show danger with mood, posture and distance, never with injury.
- Draw each named character only once.
- Show exactly the number of people, animals and things the description asks for, and no extra people.
- One clear moment that reads at a glance, as a single full-bleed picture with no border, frame or comic panels.

illustrations.anchor: Men den kvelden fikk reven vondt i magen.
illustrations.caption: Den kvelden fikk reven vondt i magen. En hel smørtønne er mye smør!
illustrations.alt: Det er kveld, og reven ligger på ryggen i snøen ved granbusken og holder seg på den runde, stramme magen. Ved siden av ligger den tomme smørtønna.
